incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Hosted inference p99 latency spike detected for /v1/stream (region: us-west-2). Auto-threshold breached (p99 > 1200ms) — paging oncall.
sam.patel: got it, pulling logs now. @oncall-rotation Im taking first pass. ETA 2m.
maya.chen: seeing stream stalls in the telemetry dashboard — a lot of backpressure on streaming workers. p95 ~ 350ms, p99 ~ 1.6s, but intermittent tails up to 3s.
luis.ortega: attaching recent tail traces (copied snippets) — looks correlated with requests routed to quantized-int8 variant of model-01.
priya.kapoor: customer-impact check: internal metrics show spike in errored streaming sessions ~0.6% during window; CS ticket volume up for two enterprise customers.
sam.patel: quick repro command I ran:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"model-01","precision":"int8","prompt":"<long-context>"}' https://api.redwood-hosted/v1/stream
# observed stalled frames and final chunk delay ~1.8s
```
maya.chen: telemetry timeline: 2026-03-15T02:12:10Z initial spike, grouped around nodes gpux-rt-09/12. KV cache evictions spike at same time.
luis.ortega: hypothesis: new auto-calibration profile for int8 rolled at 02:00 and introduced a codepath that adds a short pause when dequantizing long KV sequences -> increases tail latency for streaming.
priya.kapoor: quick impact note for sales/support: internal SLAs show only minor customer error rate but latency SLO p99 breached; flagging for postmortem and exec FYI. I'll update the incident bridge.
incident-bot: incident-12374 created; severity: P1 (SLO breach). Bridge: https://zoom/xyz. Pages: infra-oncall, ml-runtime, eng-sre.
sam.patel: mitigation options:
  1) Temporarily route streaming traffic away from int8 variants to fp16/fp32 pools (fast fallback routing).
  2) Hotpatch the calibration step to bypass extra dequant step (risky without QA).
  3) Scale up gpux pools to absorb spikes (band-aid, increases cost).
Which should we try first?
maya.chen: prefer 1) fallback routing — lowest risk and reversible. I can flip routing policy to prefer fp16 for streaming within 2-3 minutes.
luis.ortega: confirm model variants compatibility: model-01/fp16 is SSE-compatible with client expectations; small latency increase per-token but avoids stalls.
priya.kapoor: notify affected customers via out-of-band channel: sending templated note now (low urgency but transparent).
sam.patel: executing routing override now:
```
# admin action
redwoodctl routing set-policy --endpoint /v1/stream --prefer-variant fp16 --duration 30m --reason "p99 spike correlated with int8 calibration"
```
deploy-bot: Routing policy update initiated by sam.patel. ChangeID: r-20260315-004. Propagation in progress.
maya.chen: seeing propagation to edge within 45s. p99 dropping from 1.6s -> 720ms within the first minute.
luis.ortega: KV eviction rate still elevated but dequant hotspots reduced. Looks promising.
support-bot: CS queue alert: two customers reported "audio pauses" in streaming; sending acknowledgment to customers saying we're mitigating and will follow up.
sam.patel: monitoring for 10 minutes to ensure tail heals and no regression in CPU or token cost. Also capturing heap/kv metrics from gpux nodes.
priya.kapoor: created incident timeline and added customer-facing summary placeholder. Will prepare postmortem owner.
incident-bot: Note: auto-rollout for int8-calib profile #c345 applied at 02:00Z — investigated as potential root cause.
maya.chen: after 7m: p99 stabilized ~510ms, p95 ~220ms, error rate back to baseline. Scaling not required.
luis.ortega: next steps:
  - revert calibration rollout to previous profile for int8 (rollback schedule)
  - run offline regression tests on long-context dequant path
  - add a canary traffic rule that excludes streaming endpoints from aggressive int8 rollouts
sam.patel: I'm going to schedule rollback of the int8 profile. Will coordinate with release mgr. ETA 25m for rollback completion.
priya.kapoor: handoff: I'm leaving for 30m; @sam.patel will be primary. @luis.ortega please own post-incident regression. I'll handle comms and postmortem doc.
oncall-rotation: acknowledged handoff. I'll be available for escalation. Logging final action items to incident-12374.
sam.patel: rollback command queued (requires approval):
```
redwoodctl calib rollback --profile int8/model-01 --to-checkpoint c342 --approve-by sam.patel
```
deploy-bot: Rollback queued. Waiting for release approver.
luis.ortega: approving rollback now.
deploy-bot: Rollback started. Expected completion ~15m. Will post update on completion.
incident-bot: incident-12374 status -> mitigated (tail reduced; routing override active; rollback in progress). Severity downgraded to P2 for tracking.
priya.kapoor: final customer note drafted; will send after rollback completes if stable. :white_check_mark:
sam.patel: leaving final log snippets for oncall:
- root-cause suspected: int8 calibration auto-rollout introduced a dequant pause under long KV contexts
- immediate mitigation: routing override to fp16 for streaming
- rollback in-flight
- postmortem owners: luis.ortega (root cause & regression), priya.kapoor (comms), sam.patel (mitigation & playbook update)
oncall-rotation: thanks team. I'll monitor for 60m and re-open paging if p99 > 800ms. Closing Slack thread after rollback confirmation.
support-bot: CS notified: customers acknowledged. No escalations so far.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed successfully. profile state -> c342. Time: 2026-03-15T02:43:21Z
maya.chen: verified telemetry post-rollback: p99 steady at 480ms for 10m. Marking incident as resolved in bridge.
incident-bot: incident-12374 resolved. Please file postmortem within 72h.
